description: This dataset collects the boundaries of conservation areas in England, areas of special architectural or historic interest designated under the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 whose character planning decisions must preserve or enhance. It is published by the planning data service of the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government, which gathers authoritative data from local planning authorities and fills gaps with Historic England data and other layers found on data.gov.uk. On 2026-09-26 the page listed 10,667 conservation areas from 152 data providers, with the collector last run on 25 September 2026. Coverage is England; individual councils, such as West Lindsey, also publish their own layers on data.gov.uk. Access: download and API through planning.data.gov.uk. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0, with attribution to Historic England and Ordnance Survey; free. Caveats: the service calls the data a work in progress, incomplete and with duplicate areas still being reconciled. Simulation uses are constraints on retrofit, solar and flood-protection measures for historic buildings and streetscapes, and planning scenarios. Related records: the Scotland building standards register and UK planning decision data.
